lines.t: (Intro)
I was walking in a rhythm that was all my own
A little too much pride, a heart turned into stone
I was looking for the glitter, missing all the gold
Trying to buy a story that had already been told
Yeah, I was spinning my wheels in the middle of the street
Missing every person that I was meant to meet.
(Pre-Chorus)
It’s like I’m waking up from a long, long sleep
The water’s shallow, but the love is deep
And I’m ready now, yeah, I’m ready now.
(Chorus)
I’m not wasting my time, not a minute more
I found a brand new life when I walked through that door
I’m giving You the lead, yeah, You’ve got the floor
(Falsetto) Higher than I’ve ever been before
No, I’m not wasting my time anymore
Every second's Yours, that's for sure.
(Verse 2)
It’s a different kind of feeling, a different kind of glow
You took the "maybe later" and You turned it into "go"
Now there’s melody in every little thing I do
Spent twenty-something years just to find my way to You
And I’m trading in the static for a clearer sound
Feet are on the rhythm, but I’m off the ground.
(Pre-Chorus)
It’s like I’m waking up from a long, long sleep
The water’s shallow, but the love is deep
And I’m ready now, yeah, I’m ready now!
(Chorus)
I’m not wasting my time, not a minute more
I found a brand new life when I walked through that door
I’m giving You the lead, yeah, You’ve got the floor
(Falsetto) Higher than I’ve ever been before
No, I’m not wasting my time anymore.
Time is a gift, and I’m opening it up
You’re the living water filling my cup
(Drums build with a funky guitar scratch)
Yeah, I’m wide awake!
I’m not wasting my time, not a minute more
I found a brand new life when I walked through that door
I’m giving You the lead, yeah, You’ve got the floor
(Falsetto) Higher than I’ve ever been before
No, I’m not wasting my time anymore.
(Outro)
(Falsetto ad-libs) No more wasting... no more wasting...
Everything I have belongs to You
(Abrupt funky finish)
